reviews.t: Love the product, just not from Amazon
reviews.x: I LOVE and use Evanhealy Rosehip Oil all the time, however the one I ordered from Amazon smelled bad and was an off color. I am saying this having bought this same product about 7 other times either directly from the supplier, or at one of those fancy stores. It is normal for each batch to be different.  I have seen differences in color, and some small differences with smell, however this specific product was way off. I would not buy again from Amazon, but from the supplier or stores.

I purchased a trial kit at my local health food store that contained this item. I am extremely happy with all of the evan healy items. I spend a lot on skin care (always have) and it has been years since I have actually got excited about my skin care regime. I have sensitive skin with an oily t-zone. This has calmed both problems down in a few short days. This is an all natural product-nothing funky or hard to pronounce on the list of ingredients. Since I started using this, I have not had to ex

Love this product!  I’m 57 years old with a face that is in collagen decline and tends to often be dry.  This product truly helps.  I especially make sure that I use it before bed to nourish my skin through the night.  Lately, I’ve been using it during the day as well.

reviews.t: perfect for irritated skin and chapped lips
reviews.x: I recently had a bad chemical allergic reaction to Urban Decay and I think also the Bare Minerals I was using.  My eyes became swollen and angry and the rest of my face broke out in tiny pustules and bumps.  I had been wearing the same products for years but I read abotu gradual progression of chemical allergies.  So i threw everything out including the brushes, i didnt want to take any chances. I just discovered Evan Healy at my Whole Foods.  I needed something to calm my irritated skin down so

I have oily/acne prone skin and acne scars. Nothing has ever kept my skin blemish free. I've always had something going on. I decided to give this product a try. I have NOT had one breakout OR blemish in 3months!!!!! I use it AM/PM, it absorbs quickly(make sure to apply to damp skin) and it doesn't interfere with my makeup during the day. I am amazed at how well this cleared my skin up.(and I work for a prestige skin care line!) absolutely recommend this product!!!!

reviews.t: Big disappointment from Smallflower seller of Evanhealy cosmetics
reviews.x: This review is not about Evanhealy product but about the seller - Smallflower. The description of the product is very confusing and doesn't say if it's a Blue or Rose serum. It says that it's rose only on the photo of the package, which I didn't even look at, since I know Evanhealy products very well and use them for few years already. So I received the rose one, when I was sure that I bought the blue. I asked for the replacement and company sent me completely different product first and now the
Evan Healy does facial serums better than anybody, as far as I can tell.  This one has an immediate softening and comforting effect on my skin, and it makes some of the little lines disappear, too.

reviews.t: Great product except for stains on clothes and excellent packaging and delivery from seller
reviews.x: I have been using Evan Healy products almost exclusively for the last few years.  The serum is great, although I dilute it a little with some of the Rose HydroSoul (their spelling - - I guess they can't call it an actual hydrosol for some reason).  I am in my seventies and my skin is still fairly smooth, which I attribute to the use of the Evan Healy products.  My only complaint is that I have orange rings on the front of most of my light colored shirts from the serum and once the shirts have be

Evan Healy is a great line of skincare. The Rosehip Treatment oil is used after spraying with one of the atomizers to help it blend into the skin evenly. I have combination skin that is sensitive and find this product very soothing and moisturizing without making me greasy or clogging my pores. Very pleasant to use and a little goes a long way.

The best skin care products I have ever used!  And believe me, I have tried a few in my 64 years! I initially was skeptical because the mixture of oil and water seemed counterintuitive, but the they leave my skin feeling clean, but with an 'open', not harsh kind of feeling.

reviews.t: It's the most amazing facial product I've ever used
reviews.x: It's the most amazing facial product I've ever used. I tried a different serum previously and went back to the rose hip because it really made such a visible difference in my skin.

The oil and facial tonic water seemed nice at first. i have different skin types during different seasons. this is winter so it's typically dry and in need of much moisiture. i used it and not one day had passed i started to break out and after a few days i had black heads all over my face and neck. i think this oil doesn't soak into skin it sits on tops as the molecules are to to big and don't permeate the skin. not a good products for those who are susceptible to breaking out or developing bla

Don't be backed off by the fact that this is oil.  I have combination skin and this oil, combined with the Rose Geranium spray, has really done wonders for my skin!  I use the oil sparingly...as in one pump combined with 5-7 sprays of the spray.  I rub it together in my hands and pat it over my face and neck.  I use a drop of oil under my eyes full strength.  Pat it under the eye with your ring finger. The 2 products combined, have the effect of a decongestant on your skin.

Tried this first as a sample and fell in love with the company, their practices and products. The scent of this is divine to me, something like honey. Add a couple drops in your palm, dilute with a floral water (Their lavender hydrosol is lovely, but I even use Andalou naturals toner) and apply to a clean face. Skin instantly revived! I've had no breakouts from the oil. Daily use leaves my skin radiant and glowing.

reviews.t: Product not the same as Whole Foods
reviews.x: I normally buy this at Whole Foods & love it. The one I bought online turned my face orange & seemed different than the bottle from Whole Foods.  I wouldn't buy from here again

I searched long and hard for an organic skin care line, and after a year of trying all kinds of things, I lucked upon the Evan Healy products.  My skin now looks and feels healthy, and I am actually getting compliments now on how good I look!  Best of all, this company supports people who might otherwise have no source of income.  It's a win-win all around!
Very nice, high quality oil. I use it daily mixed with rose water. It leaves my face feeling smooth, moisturized, and soft. The scent is faintly rose and pleasant.
One squirt every morning, one squirt every evening!  Then add your favorite lotion

reviews.t: I love this stuff! Great on the skin, works as sunscreen too!
reviews.x: This is some great skin oil.  I am recent to the skin oil and it has changed how I view skincare.  I bought it at the local Whole Foods.  The scent is earthy but very pleasant and it really makes the skin look great.  I have very fair skin and I have some issues with the sun--some photo-discoloration and a history of skin cancer.  The carrot seed oil in it is great for natural sunscreen (apparently has an spf ranging from 20-35), and the rosehip seed oil is a great emollient and helps fade scars

reviews.t: So I bought a sample set and loved this product
reviews.x: So I bought a sample set and loved this product, then I bought a whole bottle and it's turning my skin a shade of orange with all the carrot oil in it. What the? The tester at the store was a lighter color than the one I brought home. I'm only using it at night now but after I'm done I won't be buying this again. I'm guessing carrot oil is a cheap filler. But very disappointed I feel like it was bait and switch.

reviews.t: Love the light smell of roses
reviews.x: the serum quickly absorbs into my skin. I use it on my face, and on the backs of my hands and on the tops of my feet. I live in the desert, and my skin is constantly drying out. Love the light smell of roses. The product both soothes and refreshes; my skin is replenished with this product.

At age 58, I finally found a moisturizer that did not break out my skin.  This stuff makes my skin look great and it feels soft and no breakouts or redness.  Use it with the cleanser and facial tonic for great skin that breaths!

reviews.t: complexion just like a spring chicken
reviews.x: Lovely...I've used for years...complexion just like a spring chicken!  ha! No...it is really terrific...use with the tonic.
It works for some people, but for me it did not help with my rosacea and acne prone skin

reviews.t: Smell is over bearing and amount is minimal
reviews.x: I can't get over the smell. If youI me a citronella type of fragrance hanging around you then this is the product for you. Used twice and I just can't stand it. I actually took a beauty wipe and proceeded to get this off my face. Also, the price is high for such a small amount though I can't think of what I would ever use this for...perhaps on candles to keep the mosquitoes away? An experiment for this summer I suppose.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the product and report visible improvements in their skin, calling it the best facial product they've used.
Reviewers with oily, combination, sensitive, or acne-prone skin report it soothes, moisturizes, and prevents breakouts without clogging pores.
Several reviewers note the oil works best when diluted with a hydrosol or floral water and applied to damp skin.
A few reviewers received product that seemed off—bad smell, off color, turned their face orange, or caused breakouts—and suspect it differs from what they buy in stores.
Some negative reviews are about the seller rather than the product, citing confusing descriptions or disappointment with the seller.
